help.title: How can we help?
help.intro: Find quick answers below, or get in touch with the store.

track.a: Open Account, then Track Orders, and choose the order. As a guest, use Track an order with your order number and the email you checked out with.

payment.a: You can pay by card or in cash when your order arrives. The ways the store takes are shown at checkout.

delivery.a: Each delivery option at checkout shows how many days it takes. You can follow your parcel from the order once it ships.

cancel.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
cancel.a: While the order has not shipped, open it and choose Cancel order. For other changes, message the store.

returns.a: Open the delivered order and choose Return items. The store tells you which items can go back and how you get your refund.

account.q: How do I change my password or details?
account.a: Open Account, then Profile for your details, or Security for your password and signing in.

help.moreBody: The store’s help centre has answers to everything else.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your account
accountDeletion.intro: You can delete your {storeName} account, and the personal details kept with it, at any time.
accountDeletion.inAppSteps: Sign in, open Account, then Security, and choose Delete account. Enter your password to confirm.
accountDeletion.signIn: Sign in to delete your account
accountDeletion.cannotSignInReset: Reset your password first, then delete your account as above.
accountDeletion.cannotSignInContact: Or contact the store from the email address on your account, asking for it to be deleted.
accountDeletion.whatGoes: Your profile, saved addresses, sign-in details (password and two-step verification), cart, wishlist, reviews, notifications, registered devices, followed stores, pre-order waiting lists, unfinished checkouts and chats with the shopping assistant. Your name and contact details are removed from your support conversations, and your email address and connection details from your blog comments, which stay under the name you posted them with. You are signed out on every device. This happens at once and cannot be undone.
accountDeletion.whatStays: Your orders, with the details on them, and your returns, quote requests and store credit stay with the store as its financial records, which it has to keep.
